fee_notes: Initial Franchise Fee is $47,900 for the first franchise, paid in full at execution of Franchise Agreement. Additional franchises: 75% of then-current fee for the second OXI FRESH Business, and 65% for the third and subsequent. Veterans may receive a 10% discount. Optional Commercial/Pull System Training Fee is $400 per attendee. Optional Dryer Vent Cleaning Initial Fee is $10,000 (1 unit), $15,000 (2 units), or $20,000 (3+ units), with a 50% discount if the Dryer Vent Addendum is signed simultaneously with the Franchise Agreement. A $5,000 Territory Reservation Deposit may be credited toward the Initial Franchise Fee. Reduced fees have been negotiated in certain cases for large multi-unit acquisitions.
raw_excerpt: You must pay to us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") of $47,900 for your first franchise. The Initial Franchise Fee is paid in full when you execute the Franchise Agreement.
